_note: Sound library (scripts/prepare_audio_library.js): every pack with its source, licence and files. seconds = length; mean_db / peak_db = measured level in dBFS; gain_db levels the file to a mean of -20 dBFS without its peak passing -1 dBFS. The sound table (audio_sfx.json) and the music table (audio_music.json) pick files from here; the Klangwerkstatt lists them.
